description: Header file defining the ProofSourceX509 class, which manages X.509 certificates with private keys for QUIC protocol cryptography, including certificate selection, proof generation, and signature computation.

classes.name: ProofSourceX509
classes.description: Manages X.509 certificates with private keys, providing methods for proof generation, certificate selection, and TLS signature computation within the QUIC protocol.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a ProofSourceX509 instance with a default certificate chain and key, used when no specific SubjectAltName match is found.

methods.name: GetProof
methods.description: Generates cryptographic proof for the server, given connection parameters and a callback.

methods.name: GetCertChain
methods.description: Retrieves the certificate chain for a given hostname, indicating if it matches SNI.

methods.name: ComputeTlsSignature
methods.description: Computes a TLS signature using the specified algorithm and input data.

methods.name: SupportedTlsSignatureAlgorithms
methods.description: Returns the list of supported TLS signature algorithms.

methods.name: GetTicketCrypter
methods.description: Returns the TicketCrypter used for session ticket encryption.

methods.name: AddCertificateChain
methods.description: Adds a new certificate chain and private key to the verifier, overriding older certificates with the same SubjectAltName.
